item.text: The repository is intentionally minimal: it has only an activity function and one test, with no web framework or database. I’m going to keep this first version dependency-free and provide an in-memory scheduling service plus a Node HTTP interface, with a pluggable delivery function so real email can be connected later without changing the customer-facing API.

item.text: The end-to-end path is now in place: customers can create, view, and delete daily/weekly CSV or JSON schedules from the browser or API, and due reports are generated and delivered through an injectable delivery hook. I’m adding the lightweight background tick for running due schedules when the service is started, then I’ll do one HTTP-level smoke check.

Implemented scheduled report delivery.

- Added daily/weekly schedules with CSV/JSON formats.
- Added browser configuration UI at `/`.
- Added schedule APIs:
  - `POST/GET /api/schedules`
  - `DELETE /api/schedules/:id`
  - `POST /api/run-due`
- Added background due-schedule processing.
- Added injectable delivery hook for email/provider integration.
- Updated README and npm start script.

Verified with the existing test suite plus schedule and HTTP smoke tests.
